title: Why $1B Exits are Dead

reader_summary.headline: Anthropic and Open AI are adding more revenue per month than meta, Google or Microsoft.
reader_summary.overview: Anthropic and Open AI are adding more revenue per month than meta, Google or Microsoft. And I wouldn't be surprised if the combination of those two companies is doing 200 billion of revenue run rate. Between 2020 and 2024, top 1% exit started at $10 billion.

thesis: The speakers argue that AI frontier labs are already generating monthly revenue growth comparable to major hyperscalers like Meta, Google, and Microsoft, despite the technology's adoption in the broader economy remaining under five percent. They contend that this disparity between massive revenue potential and early-stage diffusion suggests extraordinary outcomes are imminent, particularly as cost pressures force a reevaluation of open-source and local models.
